methods.description: Compare the pinned Natural Earth group component with the existing Henderson ring after coordinate rounding; ring start and winding are ignored. No geographic measurement or shoreline accuracy assessment.

metrics.unit: vertices after rounding to 4 decimal places

summaries.unit: vertices after rounding to 4 decimal places

conclusions.text: The current Henderson outline has a reproducible lineage match to the third component of the pinned Natural Earth four-island Pitcairn Islands Admin-1 feature after rounding to four decimal places.
Henderson belongs to the Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands group; the Atlas parent and child-count context are preserved.
No dedicated current authoritative island coastline source was obtained from the bounded sources inspected; full shoreline and small-islet completeness remain unresolved.
The existing coordinates are not demonstrated to be legally authoritative or positionally accurate as a current shoreline.
